metadata.case_name: CHONG YIU TAT v. FONG MAN CHI & OTHERS

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: indoor cleaner and a car-park attendant

injuries.description: By the accident Chong sustained a pilon (distal end) fracture of the left tibia involving the ankle joint.
source: By the accident Chong sustained a pilon (distal end) fracture of the left tibia involving the ankle joint.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: He initially suffered from post-traumatic oedema.
Chong still suffers from residual pain and stiffness of the left ankle, with a chance of degenerative arthritis.
The pain and stiffness are aggravated when Chong walks on uneven surfaces or goes for prolonged walks.
He will have to minimise strenuous use of his left ankle in the future.
Chong cannot return to his pre-injury occupation of installing air-conditioners at construction sites.

treatments_received: close reduction and external fixation (operation on 17 September 1998)
treatments_future: possible future surgical treatment for degenerative arthritis

losses.description: Residual pain and stiffness of the left ankle, aggravated on uneven surfaces or prolonged walks; will have to minimise strenuous use of left ankle.
Cannot return to his pre-injury occupation of installing air-conditioners at construction sites.
